Name: Inspectated Customized Dialogue
Author: Inspectator
Description:
[center]Hello, welcome to my [size=1]small[/size] mod. [/center]
[center]The plan is to make the villagers more receptive/reactive to the world around them and the player. Villagers should react in a way that game, making it feel more dynamic and responsive to the player's choices. I also want to reveal more villagers tastes organically through dialogue (which will show up on the gift log). In the short term I am focusing on year 1 and obvious choices and long term I want that villagers react to most significant things that the player does.[/center]

[line]
[center]So what do I consider to be dialogue?[/center]
[color= #d4dd2f][center]If there is text and it is connected to a NPC, it's fair game. However, most of the changes are through traditional dialogue.[/center][/color]

[center]Is this compatible with Canon-Friendly Dialogue?[/center]
[center][color=#25a4d3]Yes, some dialogue interactions may overlap but the mods will run side by side.[/color][/center]
[center]Is this compatible with (Insert mod)?[/center]
[center][color=#51fcad]Probably? This mod doesn't change much so I'm sure most mods will leave it alone. It should be noted, however, the dialogue changes are derived from the base game so some dialogue will not make sense if your game is heavily modded in ways that change the NPCs' behaviors.[/color][/center]
[line]

I recommend waiting until beta to install this mod as not much has been changed besides some situational dialogue and a few niche interactions.

There is a topic that can be used if you find a typo.

If there is a bug, the mod would likely not load or you won't see what you missed but I you find one you know what to do.
[center]
Quick Notes: [/center]
[list]
[*]Penny pre-Pam birthday dialogue is bugged (fixed in next update)
[*]﻿Updates will be slower and change more from now on so as to not bombard you with redownloading every few days.
[/list]
